menu = {"coffee": 3, "bagel": 2, "muffin": 4}

for item in menu:                  # loops over the KEYS
    print("{} costs ${}".format(item, menu[item]))

for item, price in menu.items():   # keys AND values together
    print("{}: ${}".format(item, price))
